column1: Required  Your product's unique ID  Tip: Enter a unique ID to help Google distinguish each product from the others. Use SKUs as your IDs where possible.
column2: Required  Your product's title  Up to 150 characters  Tip: Clearly identify what you're selling. A specific and accurate title can help Google show your product to the right customers.
column3: Required  Your product's description  Up to 200 characters  Tip: List the most important details about your product. Use bullets and paragraphs to make the description easy to read for customers.
column4: Required  Your product's availability  Tip: tell customers whether you have your product or not. Enter one of the following: "in_stock", "out_of_stock", "preorder", "backorder".
column5: Required if availability is "preorder" or "backorder"  The date, with time and timezone, on which a preordered or backordered product becomes available for delivery  Tip: enter the date in one of the following formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[±hhmm] or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
column6: Optional  The date, with time and time zone, on which your product should stop showing  Tip: enter the date in one of the following formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[±hhmm] or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
column7: Required  Your product's landing page link  Tip: provide a link that will allow customers to open a landing page on your website for that product
column8: Optional  Your product's mobile-optimised landing page link  Tip: use when you have a different link pointing to your mobile and desktop
column9: Required  The link pointing to your product's main image  Tip: make sure that your image is available in one of the following formats: JPEG (.jpg/.jpeg), WebP (.webp), PNG (.png), GIF (.gif), BMP (.bmp), TIFF (.tif/.tiff)
column10: Required  Your product's price  Your product's price
column11: Optional  Your product's price during a sale  Tip: make sure that your sale price includes the currency code such as USD, CAD, EUR, GBP (as specified in ISO 4217)
column12: Optional  The date range, with time and time zone, during which the product's sale price applies  Tip: enter a start date and an end date in the one of the following formats: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[±hhmm] or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ, separated by slash ( / )
column13: Required  Indicates that your product has a unique identification number such as GTIN, MPN, UPC, EAN, JAN, or ISBN  Tip: enter one of the following: "yes", "no". You might not have a unique identification number if you sell products such as flowers, bouquets, gift baskets, or handmade goods.
column14: Required if your product has a manufacturer-assigned identification number known as GTIN  Your product's Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)  Tip: you can use UPC (12 digits), EAN (13 digits), JAN (8 or 13 digits), ISBN (10 or 13 digits), or ITF-14 (14 digits) as your GTIN too. Not required if you sell products that don't have GTINs such as flowers, bouquets, gift baskets, or handmade goods.
column15: Required if your product has a manufacturer-assigned identification number known as MPN  Your product's Manufacturer Part Number (MPN)  Tip: if you're a manufacturer, your MPN can be identical to your SKU. Not required if you sell products that don't have MPNs such as flowers, bouquets, gift baskets, or handmade goods.
column16: Required  Your product's brand name  Tip: use the brand name of the product that customers generally will recognize
column17: Optional but beneficial  The most relevant highlights of your products  Up to 150 characters  Tip: include as many highlights as possible to help customers scan sentence fragments that answer the most common questions or that call out the most important aspects of the product
column18: Optional but beneficial  Technical specifications or additional details of your product  Tip: include as many details as possible to help answer any questions customers might have about your product. Enter your details in the following format: "section_name: attribute_name: attribute_value".
column19: Optional but beneficial  The link pointing to your product's additional images  Tip: use to show your product from different angles or in use. Additional images are often critical for customers to understand what the product looks like. The same formats apply as for the main image.
column20: Required if your product is used or refurbished  The condition of your product at time of sale  Tip: enter one of the following: "new", "refurbished", "used"
column21: Required if a product contains adult content  Indicates that your product includes sexually suggestive content  Tip: enter one of the following: "yes", "no"
column22: Required for apparel products  Your product's colour  Tip: use for electronics, home goods, appliances, and anything that differentiates by color. If your product is made up of several colours, you can specify 1 primary colour followed by up to 2 secondary colours that are each separated by a slash (/).  For example: Red/Green/Black
column23: Required for apparel products  Your product's size  Tip: use for electronics, home goods, sporting goods, or apparel if you want your product to appear in results that are filtered by size. Enter a single size per product.
column24: Optional  Your clothing product's cut  Tip: enter one of the following: "regular", "petite", "plus", "tall", "big", "maternity"
column25: Optional  The country of the size system used by your product  Tip: use to help customers narrow search results. Enter one of the following: "AU","BR","CN" (China), "DE","EU","FR", "IT", "JP", "MEX", "UK", "GB".
column26: Required for apparel products  The gender for which your product is intended  Tip: enter one of the following: "female", "male", "unisex"
column27: Required for apparel & distinguishing different products  Your product's fabric or material  Tip: describe the main fabric or material that your product is made of
column28: Required for apparel & distinguishing different products  Your product's pattern or graphic print  Up to 200 characters  Tip: use to help customers narrow search results
column29: Required for apparel & toys  The demographic for which your product is intended  Tip: enter one of the following: "newborn", "infant", "toddler", "children", "adult"
column30: Required for products sold in Australia, Brazil, Czechia, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, Spain, Switzerland, the UK, or the US  The number of identical products sold within a merchant-defined multipack  For example: one multipack could consist of 3 packages containing 4 manufacturer-packed pens each
column31: Required for products sold in Australia, Brazil, Czechia, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, Spain, Switzerland, the UK, or the US  Indicates that your product is a merchant-defined custom group of different products featuring one main product  Tip: enter one of the following: "yes", "no"  For example: a video console (main product) with 3 video games could be a bundle
column32: Required for special country regulations  The measure and dimension of your product as it is sold  Tip: enter the measure in the following format: a number with a unit such as oz, lb, mg, g, kg, floz, pt, qt, gal, ml, cl, l, cbm, in, ft, yd, cm, m, sqft, sqm, or ct  For example: 750 ml
column33: Required for special country regulations  The product's unit base measure for pricing  Tip: enter the unit measure in the following format: a number with a unit such as oz, lb, mg, g, kg, floz, pt, qt, gal, ml, cl, l, cbm, in, ft, yd, cm, m, sqft, sqm, or ct  For example: 100 ml, which means that the price is calculated based on a unit of 100 ml
column34: Required for special country regulations  Your product's energy label  Tip: enter one of the following: "A+++", "A++", "A+", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"
column35: Required for special country regulations  Your product's minimum energy class  Tip: enter one of the following: "A+++", "A++", "A+", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"
column36: Required for special country regulations  Your product's maximum energy class  Tip: enter one of the following: "A+++", "A++", "A+", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"
column37: Required for products sold in Brazil, France, Germany, Japan, the UK, or the US & being a variant  The ID for a group of products that come in different versions (variants)  Tip: use to group your product and its variants to show them together to customers. Use parent SKUs as your group IDs where possible.
column38: Required for Buy on Google  The total number of your product available to sell  Tip: use to indicate how many units of your product you want to sell "on Google"
